title: 暖金色奶油感
prompt: Edit this photograph with a restrained golden-hour cream palette. Preserve the original composition, subject identity, skin texture and all scene details. Warm the highlights gently toward pale honey, keep midtones natural, soften the highlight roll-off and lift the deepest shadows slightly without flattening the image. Keep whites ivory rather than yellow and greens muted rather than brown. Retain believable local contrast and fine detail. Do not add sunlight, flare, bokeh or objects that are absent from the source. Avoid orange skin, excessive smoothing and clipped highlights.

title: 复古胶片
prompt: Create a subtle color-negative film interpretation of this photograph. Keep the framing, geometry, faces and existing light direction unchanged. Use a gentle contrast curve, softly compressed highlights, slightly lifted blacks and restrained saturation. Let warm reds and cooler greens remain distinct without a heavy color cast. Add very fine, irregular luminance grain appropriate to the image resolution, preserving edges and skin detail. Keep shadow information readable. Do not add date stamps, borders, scratches, artificial light leaks or invented scene elements. Aim for a quiet scanned-print feeling, not a vintage filter overlay.

title: 电影感夜景
prompt: Grade this night photograph with a cinematic but credible separation of cool ambient shadows and warm practical lights. Preserve the original buildings, signs, people, reflections and light sources exactly. Recover bright sign detail where present, retain deep blacks with visible texture, and reduce distracting color noise without erasing detail. Use a restrained contrast curve and subtle local emphasis on the existing subject. Keep mixed lighting believable; do not force every shadow toward teal. Do not invent neon signs, rain, fog, reflections, lens flare or extra lights. Preserve the original aspect ratio.

title: 建筑透视修正
prompt: Correct the architectural perspective of this photograph conservatively. Level the horizon and align structural verticals while preserving the building's real proportions, facade details, windows, signs and materials. Use the smallest geometric correction necessary; do not widen or stretch the upper floors excessively. Preserve natural depth and the original lighting. Crop only as needed to remove empty correction edges, and keep as much of the composition as possible. Do not reconstruct missing architecture or generate new content beyond the image boundary. Leave people, lettering and repeating facade patterns intact.

title: 人像氛围感
prompt: Refine this portrait with a quiet, natural atmosphere. Preserve the person's identity, facial proportions, age, expression, body shape and clothing. Keep pores, freckles and fine hair visible. Gently balance exposure on the face, soften only distracting tonal transitions and reduce temporary color casts while respecting the existing light direction. Separate the subject through modest local contrast and restrained background saturation, not invented blur. Keep skin tones believable across highlights and shadows. Do not reshape features, whiten skin unnaturally, enlarge eyes, remove permanent features or replace the background.

title: 自然风光
prompt: Develop this landscape photograph with natural depth and balanced color. Preserve the original sky, terrain, water, vegetation, weather and time-of-day cues. Recover highlight and shadow detail only where the source contains it. Use subtle local contrast to clarify layers, maintain realistic greens and blues, and keep distant atmospheric haze believable. Protect fine textures and smooth gradients in the sky. Avoid oversharpening, edge halos, excessive dehaze and HDR-like microcontrast. Do not replace the sky, add sun rays, change seasons, remove major landscape elements or invent reflections.
